tasks.label: Lint: everything
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e RUN_MIGRATIONS=false php composer lint

tasks.label: Lint: static analysis
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e RUN_MIGRATIONS=false php composer lint:stan -- --error-format=raw | sed 's#/var/www/html/##'

tasks.label: Lint: code style
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e RUN_MIGRATIONS=false php composer lint:style

tasks.label: Fix: code style (whole project)
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e RUN_MIGRATIONS=false php composer fix:style

tasks.label: Fix: code style (current file)
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -e RUN_MIGRATIONS=false php vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix '${relativeFile}'
